name: Stackable Totems (up to 64)
summary: Allows you to stack totems up to 64
description: # Stackable Totems of Undying ## Description **Stackable Totems of Undying** is a simple tweak mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that allows Totems of Undying to stack up to 64. No more wasting inventory space on single totems—now you can carry a full stack and use them one by one. ### How It Works (for the user) - Totems of Undying now stack up to 64, just like most other items. - When you are holding a stack of totems and would die, one totem is consumed from the stack (decreasing the count by 1), and you are saved as usual. - The totem's functionality remains unchanged; only the stack size is increased. ### Features - Totems stack to 64. - Works exactly as expected: using a totem reduces the stack count.
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
